# Gamintraveler

> > Gamintraveler is a travel blog and destination guide resource created by multicultural couple Ruben and Rachel, sharing travel stories, backpacking tips, and digital nomad experiences since 2014.

The site focuses on destination guides and practical travel advice, with particular emphasis on South America (Peru, Colombia, Brazil), Spain, Costa Rica, Mexico, and Asia. Ruben and Rachel provide authentic travel connectivity insights and cultural perspectives from their journeys as a multicultural couple exploring the world.
